# technitium_allowed_zone (Resource)

Allows a domain and all its subdomains even when a block list or blocked zone matches it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_allowed_zone" "cdn" {
  domain = "cdn.example.org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, e.g. `ads.example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain name; also the import ID.

## Import

```shell
terraform import technitium_allowed_zone.cdn cdn.example.org
```
